auth.title: Access token required
auth.description: This server is exposed beyond localhost and requires an access token. It is configured with --auth-token or the OURBOROS_TOKEN environment variable.

tray.noMounts: No mounts yet. Create one on the Mounts page of the main window.

command.title: Quick commands
command.description: Search and run an Ourboros command

overview.connectionDescription: rclone is not started automatically. Once connected, the version, system and address show up here.
overview.binaryDescription: Choose which rclone executable to use for this session.
overview.noBinary: No usable rclone found. Install or download one, then retry.
overview.managedDescription: Download official rclone releases and activate them locally.

files.locationDescription: rclone must be running to list files.
files.empty: This directory is empty, or rclone is not running.
files.deleteDirConfirm: Delete directory "{{name}}" and all of its contents?
files.targetPlaceholder: remote name (or remote/sub/dir) or absolute local path
files.targetHelp: Enter another remote name, or an absolute local path starting with /.
files.renameInvalid: Name cannot be empty or contain /

sync.title: Sync tasks
sync.subtitle: One-way and two-way sync between local directories and remotes
sync.opSyncHint: Mirror sync makes the target identical to the source. Extra files on the target may be deleted.
sync.opMoveHint: Move transfers files and removes them from the source afterwards.
sync.bisyncHint: Two-way sync (rclone bisync) propagates changes in BOTH directions, including deletions. The first run must initialize with resync.
sync.bwLimitHint: Empty = unlimited. The limit is process-wide and applies to streamed transfers (e.g. local ↔ cloud); several limited tasks at once take the smallest.
sync.maxTransferHint: Empty = unlimited. The run is aborted once the limit is reached (counts all transferred data).
sync.empty: No sync tasks yet. Create one to sync a local directory with a remote.
sync.rcloneOffline: rclone is not running. Start it before running sync tasks.
sync.impactSync: Mirror sync makes the target identical to the source. Extra files on the target may be deleted.
sync.impactMove: Files will be removed from the source after being moved.
sync.impactBisync: Changes including deletions propagate in BOTH directions.
sync.bisyncWarning: Two-way sync keeps state between the two paths. Deletions on either side propagate to the other.
sync.resyncWarning: Resync rebuilds the baseline between the two paths: files that exist on only one side are copied to the other. Use it for the first run, after changing settings, or to recover from errors. When both sides have a file, the source side wins by default.
sync.deleteWarning: This removes the sync task "{{name}}". Scheduled runs stop and the task cannot be recovered. Type the task name to confirm.

remotes.title: Remote storage
remotes.description: Pick a type, fill in the address and account. Credentials stay in rclone and never return to the browser.
remotes.empty: No remote storage yet. Once rclone is running, click "New" and fill in the form.
remotes.formDescription: Fill in the common fields. Advanced settings stay collapsed; leave them alone to use rclone's defaults.
remotes.startFirst: Start or connect rclone on the overview page first, then create a remote.
remotes.nameHint: Use this name to refer to the remote in files and sync.
remotes.moreTypes: Common types are shown first. Search to find the remaining {{count}} types.
remotes.nameInvalid: Name cannot be empty or contain spaces, colons or slashes
remotes.keepOriginal: Leave empty to keep the current value

storage.title: Storage
storage.subtitle: Manage local directories and remotes used by sync tasks
storage.localEmpty: No local storage yet. Add a directory to use it in sync tasks.
storage.localPathHint: Absolute path. Sync tasks reuse a storage with the same path automatically.
storage.remoteEmpty: No remotes yet. Create one to sync with cloud storage.
storage.deleteLocalWarning: This removes the local storage "{{name}}" ({{path}}) from Ourboros. Files on disk are not touched.
storage.deleteRemoteWarning: This deletes remote "{{name}}" from the rclone configuration, including its credentials. Sync tasks using it are not affected unless you delete them first.
storage.rcloneOfflineRemotes: rclone is not running. Remotes can be read or created once it is started.

settings.endpointDescription: When an existing rclone RC address is provided (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5572), Ourboros connects to it instead of starting its own rclone rcd. Leave empty to start a managed rclone rcd. rclone is not started automatically by default.
settings.rcUrlPlaceholder: http://127.0.0.1:5572, leave empty for managed rcd
settings.autoStart: Automatically connect to / start rclone when Ourboros starts
settings.autoStartHint: Off by default: rclone only starts when you click "Start / connect".
settings.binaryDescription: Current source {{source}}. When empty, rclone from the system PATH is used.
settings.shortcutsDescription: Active while an Ourboros window is focused. Use a format like CmdOrCtrl+Shift+O. Leave blank to restore the default.
settings.shortcutsHint: Shortcuts only work while an Ourboros window is focused, not in other apps.
settings.cliDescription: Values that come from the current process command line cannot be changed on this page.

api.title: Ourboros API playground
api.homeHint: In development Vite proxies /api and /health to 127.0.0.1:8080
api.requestDescription: Replace {id} / {edge_id} in the path with real values before sending.
api.sseNoBody: SSE does not need a body
api.methodsHint: GET / DELETE use the query; POST / PUT / PATCH send JSON.
api.responseDescription: JSON is pretty-printed; plain-text responses such as health checks stay as-is.
api.responseEmpty: The result shows up here after sending a request or connecting to SSE.

endpoints.system-info: Ourboros version, HOME and rclone status without the RC URL.
endpoints.rclone-start: Start or connect to the rclone RC.
endpoints.rclone-stop: Stop the rclone started by Ourboros.
endpoints.rclone-scan: Scan system, custom and managed rclone binaries.
endpoints.rclone-select: Select the rclone source for this process.
endpoints.rclone-delete-version: Delete a managed rclone version directory.
endpoints.remotes-create: Create a remote. The alias example does not write real cloud credentials.
endpoints.files-list: List files under fs/remote. Requires rclone to be running.
endpoints.files-download: Download a single file (fs + remote) as a stream.
endpoints.files-delete: Delete a file; purge=true deletes the directory and its contents.
endpoints.mount-start: Start a remote → local mount edge.
endpoints.settings-patch: Update settings such as the rclone source and auto start.
endpoints.rc-version: Restricted RC proxy. rclone always takes POST + JSON.
endpoints.rc-listremotes: Example of an allowed RC command.
endpoints.rc-forbidden: Should return 400: credential export commands are forbidden.
endpoints.sync-tasks-list: List sync tasks with limits and last result.
endpoints.sync-tasks-create: Create a sync task: one-way (copy/move/sync) or two-way bisync, with optional bandwidth limit and max transfer size.
endpoints.sync-tasks-patch: Update name, endpoints, operation, limits or schedule of a sync task.
endpoints.sync-tasks-delete: Delete a sync task and its unused endpoint nodes.
endpoints.sync-tasks-run: Run a sync task with the saved limits. Two-way tasks need resync=true on the first run.
endpoints.remotes-delete: Delete a remote from the rclone configuration. Rejected with 409 while sync tasks reference it.
endpoints.storage-local-create: Create a local storage node (label + absolute directory).
endpoints.storage-local-delete: Delete a local storage node. Rejected with 409 while sync tasks reference it.

errors.rcloneNotRunning: rclone is not running. Start it on the Overview page first.
errors.cliOverride: This setting is set by a startup flag and cannot be changed here.

codes.forbidden_command: This rclone operation is not allowed.
codes.not_found: The object cannot be found; it may have been deleted.
codes.io_error: Failed to read or write local files.

errors.bisyncResyncRequired: This two-way sync needs an initial resync run before it can execute.
errors.workspaceConflict: The task list changed elsewhere. Reload and try again.
errors.remoteInUse: This remote is used by sync tasks or mounts. Delete those first.
errors.nodeInUse: This storage is used by sync tasks or mounts. Delete those first.
